:::{#thm-twice-mutual-information}
#### Twice the mutual information

For [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$ and $Y$
with finite entropies,

$$2 \, I(X; Y) = \sb{\entropyf{X} - \entropyf{X \mid Y}} + \sb{\entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X}}.$$

:::

::: {.proof}

By @thm-mutual-information-symmetric,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\entropyf{X} - \entropyf{X \mid Y} &= I(X; Y) \\
\entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X} &= I(X; Y).
\end{aligned}
$$

Adding the two displays gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sb{\entropyf{X} - \entropyf{X \mid Y}} + \sb{\entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X}}
&= I(X; Y) + I(X; Y) \\
&= 2 \, I(X; Y).
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
